'''Yollo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], Yollo was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] sometime before [[3643 BBY]]. During the later stages of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Yollo resided on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Selecting the young [[Spanios]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Master Yollo and fellow Master [[Silvarte]] became suspicious of their students, believing that both Padawans Spanios and [[Moracen]] had begun a romantic relationship. To get an idea of the situation's severity, Master Silvarte sent another Padawan to discover whether the two apprentices were indeed romantically involved.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yollo is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Norm Woodel]].
